Testimonials
Mr Rajiv Kulkarni
My recent stay at Hotel Sai Palace was amazing. The personalised service and attention to detail were exceptional. The Rooms made me feel right at home. Whether you're here for business or leisure, this hotel is the perfect choice.
Mrs Ankita Sharma
Hotel Sai Palace truly defines hospitality. The facilities and the warm, welcoming staff made my stay memorable. From the moment I walked in, they took care of everything. I can't wait to return.
Harshit Poojary
As a frequent traveller, I can say that Hotel Sai Palace stands out. The  friendly, attentive staff is the best part. I was in town for business, the hotel really aided in all my work and meetings.
Mitali Patil
My stay at Hotel Sai Palace was extremely comfortable and peaceful. The attention to detail in every aspect of the hotel is impressive. You can trust them entirely. I highly recommend this place.
Arjun Bhagwant
Hotel Sai Palace exceeded my expectations in every way. The rooms are beautiful and the staff goes above and beyond to ensure your comfort.
